verdict.rationale: Slack does document export tools (slack-docs-22/23/35/36) suggesting workspace data export exists, but hands-on community reports concretely contradict open, self-service exit: Corporate Export of DMs/private channels requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval (slack-comm-2), and users question whether long-history exports are even feasible in practice (slack-comm-4). There's no evidence the export uses genuinely open/portable formats or covers all AI-surfaced data (canvases, lists, huddle notes). missing for 10: proof of open standard export format, self-service full-data export without approval gating, independent success story of a full data migration out.
